title: Southwest Bowls on your phone
subtitle: Add the website to your home screen and it opens like an app — no app store, no download, nothing to update.

sections.heading: What you get
body: A Southwest Bowls icon on your phone that opens straight to the tournaments, results and season agenda, full screen, without the browser around it.
It is always up to date: the moment a result or a tournament is published on the website, it is in the app too.
Pages you have already opened keep working when the signal at the green is poor.

sections.heading: iPhone or iPad
items: Tap the Share button (the square with an arrow pointing up) at the bottom of the screen.
Scroll down and tap “Add to Home Screen”.
Tap “Add” in the top corner. The Southwest Bowls icon appears on your home screen.

sections.heading: Android
items: Tap “Add SW Bowls to your phone” at the bottom of the home page, or open the ⋮ menu and tap “Install app” (on some phones it says “Add to Home screen”).
Tap “Install”. The Southwest Bowls icon appears with your other apps.

sections.heading: Computer
items: Open swlawnbowls.org in Chrome or Edge.
Click the install icon at the right-hand end of the address bar, then “Install”.

sections.heading: Removing it
body: Delete it like any other app: press and hold the icon, then choose Remove (iPhone) or Uninstall (Android).
